alt.description: Alt text to put in the snippet. Defaults to empty.

data.description: The image as base64 — either the file's bytes base64-encoded, or a whole data URI (data:image/png;base64,…) to inspect. Line breaks, URL-safe characters and missing padding are accepted. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, AVIF, BMP and ICO are recognised from the bytes themselves; about 5 MB of image at most. Send the whole file as it is, up to 5 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/image-to-base64 (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.
